'''September 2000 Rochester tournament (2 September)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Millenium Games and Hobby Store, Rochester, NY on 2 September 2000. [[Jon Schultz]] won it. It is known from Ted Panczyszyn's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1199">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-04-rochester-ny-9-2-2000d1199/ rochester-ny-9-2-2000], DeckTech (Ted "Rogue15" Panczyszyn, 4 September 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-04-rochester-ny-9-2-2000d1199/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 2 September 2000
* '''Site:''' Millenium Games and Hobby Store, Rochester, NY
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Jon Schultz]]
